title: HFA-ICOS initial Cardio-Oncology risque évaluation pour Anthracycline Chemotherapy
abbreviations: Heart Failure Association International Cardio-Oncology Society
formula:
The HFA-ICOS Cardiotoxicity Risk (Anthracycline) is defined by the number and severity of risk factors.
Patients with no risk factors or one **Medium** point are classified as low risk, those with two to four **Medium** points as medium risk, those with five or more Medium points or any **High** factor as high risk, and those with any **Very high** factor as very high risk.

| Variable | Factor | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Previous Cardiovascular Disease | | |
| Heart failure or cardiomyopathy | Very high | |
| Severe valvular heart disease | High | |
| Myocardial infarction or previous coronary revascularisation ( PCI or CABG ) | High | |
| Stable angina | High | |
| Baseline LVEF | >54% | Low |
| 50-54% | Medium (2 points) | |
| <50% | High | |
| Cardiac Biomarkers | | |
| Elevated baseline troponin 1 | Medium (1 points) | |
| Elevated baseline BNP or NT-proBNP 1 | Medium (1 points) | |
| Demographic and Cardiovascular Risk Factors | | |
| Age, years | <65 | Low |
| 65-79 | Medium (2 points) | |
| ≥80 | High | |
| Hypertension 2 | Medium (1 points) | |
| Diabetes mellitus 3 | Medium (1 points) | |
| Chronic kidney disease 4 | Medium (1 points) | |
| Previous Cardiotoxic Cancer Treatment | | |
| Previous anthracycline exposure | High | |
| Prior radiotherapy to left chest or mediastinum | High | |
| Previous non-anthracycline-based chemotherapy | Medium (1 points) | |
| Lifestyle Risk Factors | | |
| Current smoker or significant smoking history | Medium (1 points) | |
| Obesity ( [BMI](nabda:calc.body-mass-index-bmi-body-surface-area-bsa\) >30 kg/m 2 ) | Medium (1 points) | |

^1^Elevated above the upper limit of normal for local laboratory reference range.
^2^Systolic blood pressure (BP) >140 mm Hg or diastolic BP >90 mm Hg, or on treatment.
^3^HbA1c >7.0% or >53 mmol/mol or on treatment.
^4^Estimated glomerular filtration rate <60 mL/min/1.73m^2^.

how_to_use.why:
- Recommandé dans les [Recommandations 2022 de l'ESC sur la cardio-oncologie](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/36017568/) pour la stratification initiale du risque cardiovasculaire chez les patients devant recevoir une anthracycline.
- Permet une surveillance et une prise en charge adaptées au risque.
how_to_use.when:
- Use before adult oncology patients begin anthracycline therapy to stratify baseline risk for cardiovascular complications related to therapy.
- Perform promptly when making cancer treatment decisions to avoid unnecessary delays in therapy.
how_to_use.pearls:
- Developed by the Heart Failure Association (HFA) of the European Society of Cardiology (ESC) and the International Cardio-Oncology Society (ICOS) to stratify baseline cardiovascular risk in cancer patients prior to potentially cardiotoxic therapies.
- Derived from expert consensus and systematic literature review.
- Estimates risk for all cardiovascular complications associated with the specific drug class; for anthracyclines, the main complications include left-ventricular dysfunction/cardiomyopathy, heart failure, and atrial and ventricular arrhythmias.
- Relies on clinical risk factors (modifiable and non-modifiable); does not account for genetic/epigenetic risk, and may underestimate risk in some low-risk patients.

next_steps.advice:
- Cet outil est une aide à la décision et doit être utilisé conjointement avec le jugement du clinicien, les préférences du patient, l’expertise spécialisée et les recommandations actuelles fondées sur les preuves/les protocoles locaux ; les résultats ne doivent pas être le seul déterminant de la prise en charge.
- La dose cumulative totale prévue du traitement par anthracyclines doit également être prise en compte dans l’évaluation du risque d’un patient (p. ex., une dose ≥250 mg/m^2^ de doxorubicine est également considérée comme à risque plus élevé).
next_steps.critical_actions: A referral to cardiology should be obtained for any patient who develops cardiotoxicity during therapy, regardless of initial risk.
next_steps.management:
- **Low risk:** Continue treatment with appropriate cardiovascular surveillance.
- **Medium risk:**

 - Provide closer monitoring of cardiovascular health.
 - Manage cardiovascular risk factors.
 - Consider cardio-oncology or cardiology referral.
- **High and very high risk:**

 - Discuss risks and benefits of proposed chemotherapy.
 - Initiate closer cardiac monitoring.
 - Refer for cardio-oncology or cardiology assessment to optimise risk factors and provide a personalised management plan.
- For more detailed guidance, please refer to the[2022 ESC guidelines](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/36017568/).

instructions:
Cet outil est spécifiquement destiné à l’évaluation du risque de cardiotoxicité du traitement par anthracyclines.

D’autres évaluations du risque de cardiotoxicité HFA-ICOS sont disponibles pour les traitements suivants :

- [Thérapies ciblant HER2](nabda:calc.hfa-icos-baseline-cardio-oncology-risk-assessment-her2-targeted-therapies).
- [Inhibiteurs du VEGF](nabda:calc.hfa-icos-baseline-cardio-oncology-risk-assessment-vegf-inhibitors).
- [Inhibiteurs de RAF et MEK](nabda:calc.hfa-icos-baseline-cardio-oncology-risk-assessment-combination-rapidly-accelerated-fibrosarcoma-raf-mitogen-activated-extracellular-signal-regulated-kinase-mek-inhibitors).
- [Inhibiteurs de kinases multi-cibles pour la CML](nabda:calc.hfa-icos-baseline-cardio-oncology-risk-assessment-multi-targeted-kinase-inhibitors-chronic-myeloid-leukaemia-cml).
- [Thérapies du myélome multiple](nabda:calc.hfa-icos-baseline-cardio-oncology-risk-assessment-multiple-myeloma-therapies).
